commands: dnf install -y git python3 python3-pip python3-devel gcc >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
if id portafolio >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '  portafolio exists'; else useradd --system --create-home --shell /bin/bash portafolio; echo '  created portafolio'; fi
if [ -d /opt/portafolio/.git ]; then echo '  repo already at /opt/portafolio'; else git clone https://github.com/Srozasc/portafolio.git /opt/portafolio; fi
echo '=== [4/9] Adapt systemd unit for AL2023 ==='
if ! grep -q '^Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1' apps/api/systemd/portafolio.service; then sed -i '/^EnvironmentFile=/a Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1' apps/api/systemd/portafolio.service; fi
if [ -d .venv ]; then echo '  venv already exists'; else python3 -m venv .venv; echo '  venv created'; fi

if [ -f .env ]; then echo '  .env already exists, leaving untouched'; else cp .env.example .env && chown portafolio:portafolio .env && chmod 600 .env && echo '  .env created from .env.example (mode 0600)'; fi
echo '=== [9/9] Enable systemd unit (not start yet, needs real .env) ==='
echo "  user:     $(id portafolio 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo NOT FOUND)"
echo "  repo:     $([ -d /opt/portafolio/.git ] && echo OK || echo MISSING)"
echo "  venv:     $([ -d /opt/portafolio/apps/api/.venv ] && echo OK || echo MISSING)"
echo "  unit:     $([ -f /etc/systemd/system/portafolio.service ] && echo OK || echo MISSING)"
echo 'NEXT: user must edit /opt/portafolio/apps/api/.env with production values, then:'
